method.description: Three-model probability blend: 45% hybrid_lr (33 feat) + 40% handcrafted_no_foldseek_lr (88 feat) + 15% KNN(k=3) on 33 feat
method.model_a: LogisticRegression(C=0.3, balanced) on 6 gate scores + 27 handcrafted = 33 features
method.model_b: LogisticRegression(C=0.3, balanced) on 88 non-foldseek handcrafted features
method.model_c: KNN(k=3, distance-weighted) on 33 features (same as model_a)

notes: Key insight: hybrid_lr (LTR=0.400, Retro=0.737) and handcrafted_lr (LTR=0.800, Retro=0.286) have complementary error profiles.
The blend captures Ty3-RT (previously missed LTR active) by shifting threshold calibration.
Result is stable across weight plateau (w_hyb in [0.42,0.56], w_hc in [0.30,0.46]).
Invariant to KNN distance metric (euclidean, manhattan, cosine all give 0.7884).
Previous benchmark (hybrid_lr, 0.7217) was a stable saddle point — this blend breaks it.
